panels.description: Pages swapped in and out per second, and major page faults. Swap in and out at similar sustained rates means the kernel is thrashing: it evicts pages that it needs again soon. Major faults also count file pages read from disk. From the node exporter, because the QNAP exporter has no vmstat counters. The node exporter is scraped every minute, so the rates use a fixed 5m window: Grafana sizes $__rate_interval from the 10s datasource interval, and a shorter window holds too few samples.
panels.title: Swap activity

panels.description: Used memory is total memory minus MemAvailable and reclaimable swap cache. Swap cache is shown separately because it is already backed by swap and can be reclaimed without I/O.
